name: Flavourings
aliases: flavourings, flavorings, flavouring, flavoring, natural flavourings, natural flavorings, artificial flavour, artificial flavor, aroma, aromas
what_is: A broad labelling category for substances or preparations added to impart or modify flavour; the exact substances covered by the term depend on the product and the applicable labelling rules.
why_botia: BOTIA flags the generic term because it may not disclose every individual flavouring substance or its source. For Muslim-choice analysis, the word flavourings alone is not enough to establish origin or religious status.
can_1: Identify generic flavourings or flavorings wording and trigger the flavour information layer.
can_2: Flag source uncertainty for the Muslim layer when the label does not provide enough information about origin, carrier or relevant certification.
cannot_1: Identify every individual flavouring compound, carrier or processing aid hidden behind a permitted collective label term.
cannot_2: Classify a generic flavouring as halal or haram without source, composition, certification or other reliable evidence.
